rule: Generalize when repeated implementations exhibit shared law and maintenance pressure; extract systems machinery when a second application would otherwise reconstruct it.

decisions.evidence: Seven scenes share one model; no second application proves compatible law.
M13-M15 qualify cadence, but commands and world-minute semantics remain local.
Mechanics repeat; target priority and failures are game law.
Concrete payloads preserve authorization, failures, replay, and events.
Plant, Chop, and Attack have distinct availability, target, and mutation laws.
One consumer and domain-coupled item/product semantics.
Semantic selection is game truth and binding lowering is closed.
Derived DotRecast boundary is sound; lifecycle contract has one consumer.
Application versions/chunks differ; container mechanics are the shared seam.
Persistent policy/flow and utility are reused without world authority.
Machina is shared; TinyFarm duplicates renderer drawing, layout realization, and hit testing.
One passive one-hit enemy does not establish a generic combat law.
Forage, Tree, and Enemy share mechanics but not semantics.
